name: Saask-store-ai-monorepo
description: Mini SaaS Multi-tenant com Agente de IA Multi-Provedor (Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform with Multi-Provider AI Agent)

scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && node scripts/postbuild.js
scripts.start: concurrently "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run preview"
